page.layout: One page: e-rara.ch digitiser's cover sheet. Logo at top right; centred title block; a rule, then a notice block of four language paragraphs in small type with a rule; a second block of licence notices in small type; Visual Library logo at bottom right. No printed book text.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not part of the printed book, so no main text is transcribed. Logos, banners and links are omitted.
